segments.text: "I exist to serve you!!"

Like Ignis, Cherry has been transformed into a submissive female slave by the hidden power of Arty Gear. She has been reborn as a bewitching female who seduces her master in a more lewd and unrestrained way than ever before.

Although she has been reborn, her naturally easy-going personality and strong curiosity have not changed... However, some parts of her have transformed into mischievous and innocent malice. In addition, by unleashing the sweetness of her kindness, she has released a part of her combat ability that she unconsciously suppressed before. Together with her innate overwhelming skill, she can now demonstrate attack power that is not inferior to Ignis. She has become especially skilled in high-lethality attack techniques.
Translated from official character description

In the second part, Cherry's personality has been transformed to be more lewd and evil without anyone around her noticing, and she has begun various clandestine activities at the school for her master's sake, deploying various traps to increase the number of new female slaves for her master.

cast.originalCharacterName: スレーブ イグニス

segments.text: "Everyone, let us offer our flames to the master!!"

Ignis was reborn through the "Magical Gear System", the true power of the S-class artifacts "Material", which serve as the core of Arty Gear and Knight Gear. Her body and mind have been remodeled by the D factor semen of the master who impregnated her, giving her a submissive and loyal personality as a female slave.

Her physical appearance reflects the master's desires and her sexual compatibility with him is excellent, serving her master wholeheartedly and enjoying a truly happy life from the bottom of her heart.
Her gear's performance has also greatly increased, allowing her to maintain a constant transformation state, or rather, "Slave Ignis" is her true form.
Translated from Part 1 official character description

Due to the devil's trap hidden in the gear in the previous installment, Ignis was transformed into the female slave of the man with the D factor, "Haibara Kai," and has now completely transformed from a dignified female knight into a devoted dog filled with allure. She will not hesitate to use her public face as the acting deputy head of the Japanese branch of the Morning Star Knights, and will work together with her new allies to fulfill any tasks for her master.
Translated from Part 2 official character description
"A gentle breeze of hope that brings happiness!!"

She is a childhood friend of Nao and also a student at the magic academy. She has a calm and easy-going personality, but when the situation calls for it, she can show a strong-willed side of herself. She is the only person who became friends with Nao, forging a deep bond between them.

In the past, she and Nao were caught up in a magical disaster, and at that time, she awakened her magical abilities and saved him from a dire situation when he was fighting to protect her. However, as they were still young, they were unable to fully confront the monsters they were facing, ultimately being saved by a magical girl.

After entering the magic academy, they spent their days training their abilities together, and after a year she was able to transform into a magical girl. Since then, she has been involved in rescue activities for magical disasters and stopping terrorist activities by magic users.
Translated from the 1st part of the official character description

In the second work, she has been showing a proactive and strong curiosity side that was not seen before, surprising those around her. This can also be seen in her relationship with Nao, as she frequently launches love attacks on him without hesitation. Her elegant and clean appearance has also become more charming since she got together with Nao, causing many male students to feel jealous of him.
[Translated from the 2nd part of the official character description
"The crimson flames are the sword of justice!!"

She is a magical girl belonging to the secret society "Morning Star Knights", which aims to dominate the world with magic abilities. She has a strong sense of pride and believes that magical abilities exist to help the weak, but she shows open hostility towards persecution of ability holders by the powerless.
She is called the "Crimson Knight" for her lovely and graceful appearance, but she also has an uncontrollable side when she becomes emotional, and some fear her as the "Crimson Witch".
She fights valiantly with a baton imbued with the power of flames that matches her image color. She has fought Arty Rain many times and they both recognize each other as worthy opponents.
Translated from the Part 1 official character description

During the second part, she was appointed as the acting branch chief of the Morning Star Knights' Japanese branch due to a certain incident, and as a result, she has gained composure, softened her demeanor, matured in appearance, and increased her feminine charm.
As a result, not only has her popularity within the Knights skyrocketed, but she has also gained fans in the school.
Translated from the Part 2 official character description

Nao's childhood friend. When they were children they were attacked by monsters and she became Magical Girl Arty Cherry. To this day she fights alongside her senior Arty Rain to protect the world from monsters.
